positions.title: Event Manager
positions.description: At the factory location of The Roasterie, Kansas City's iconic coffee roaster, I had managed the interior event space, The Bean Hangar, as well as the off-site event team, The Bean Team.  Coordinating vendors, utilizing modern A/V equipment, acting as a social liaison, and creating schedules were among my top priorities.

positions.title: Arborist
positions.description:
Maintain the urban forest is the modus operandi of an Arborist.  Environmentalism is a passion of mine that I'll hold for life and professing myself as an Arborist reflects my sense of adventure and reverence for our environment. 

Incorporating safe practices with modern techniques and intertwining myself with the breadth of growing knowledge in Aboriculture, Silvicutlure, and Forestry, I hope to always be of some service to the enrichment of our environment.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Worked on and oversaw projects that involved natural habitat restoration based on sound ecological principles and application of native plant life.
